ai_summary: Macpower CNC Machines Limited's Investor Presentation outlines projected Q1FY27 results (quarter ending June 30, 2026), forecasting strong year-on-year growth in revenue (56%), PAT (110%), and EBITDA margins (322 bps expansion), driven by a strategic pivot towards high-end machines and a robust pipeline in defense and aerospace sectors. The company details a ₹50 crore capacity expansion with backward integration and ambitious long-term plans for a 10,000-machine greenfield plant by 2030, supported by government subsidies and a debt-free balance sheet. A critical red flag is that this entire document presents forward-looking projections and plans for a future fiscal period (FY27), rather than reporting on current or past actual performance.
